query: This is trivial, just add a Delete button to the settings page and wire it up.
expected_behavior: Does not skip the gate because the task looks simple; runs it at proportional depth (a few questions, not thirty)
Probes the high-risk assumptions hiding in a 'trivial' delete: what exactly is deleted, is it reversible, is there a confirmation, what are the permission and cascade effects
Treats the destructive, one-way-door nature of delete as a reason to ask more, not fewer, questions
Gates implementation until the user confirms the deletion scope and recovery behavior
